AuthenTrend, based in Taiwan, builds a small but focused line of biometric FIDO2 keys. Their ATKey.Pro is a fingerprint USB key in zinc and standard editions, the ATKey.Card NFC is a fingerprint smart card with NFC, paired with an optional ATKey.Badge USB-C reader released in 2025. The previously sold ATKey.Hello dongle has been retired. AuthenTrend markets against NIST AAL3, NIS2, and DORA messaging for European and Asia Pacific enterprise customers.
